title: Repairing the Cracked Foundation: A Survey of Obstacles in Evaluation Practices for Generated Text

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying 66 recent Natural Language Generation (NLG) papers to quantify the percentage that evaluate models on non-English datasets, highlighting the field's over-reliance on English.

Analyzing 66 recent academic papers to track how frequently researchers report disaggregated performance results for specific subpopulations, demographics, or dialects (such as African American Vernacular English).
